iti109:2.1: (Cat.) Seyyathā pi bhikkhave puriso nadiyā sotena ovuyheyya piyarūpasātarūpena, tam-enaṃ cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito disvā evaṃ vadeyya: kiñcāpi kho tvaṃ ambho purisa nadiyā sotena ovuyhasi piyarūpasātarūpena. Atthi cettha heṭṭhā rahado saummi sāvaṭṭo sagaho sarakkhaso yaṃ tvaṃ ambho purisa pāpuṇitvā maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan-ti. Atha kho so bhikkhave puriso tassa purisassa saddaṃ sutvā hatthehi ca pādehi ca paṭisotaṃ vāyameyya.
iti109:3.1: Upamā kho me ayaṃ bhikkhave katā atthassa viññāpanāya. Ayaṃ cettha attho: Nadiyā soto ti kho bhikkhave taṇhāyetaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
iti109:4.1: piyarūpasātarūpan-ti kho bhikkhave channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
iti109:5.1: heṭṭhā rahado ti kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
iti109:7.1: sāvaṭṭo ti kho bhikkhave pañcannetaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
iti109:8.1: sagaho sarakkhaso ti kho bhikkhave mātugāmassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
iti109:9.1: paṭisoto ti kho bhikkhave nekkhammassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
iti109:10.1: hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyāmo ti kho bhikkhave viriyārambhassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
iti109:11.1: cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito ti kho bhikkhave Tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassā-ti. Sahāpi dukkhena jaheyya kāme* yogakkhemaṃ āyati
iti109:12.1: patthayāno | sammappajāno suvimuttacitto vimuttiyā phassaye tattha tattha || Sa vedagū vūsitabrahmacariyo lokantagū pāragato ti vuccatīti ||10||* **
